Select IC50 activity records for CHEMBL5498743 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL612267. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL5498743 to include all child salts. Retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ salts path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target CHEMBL612267. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
